sourceProof.proof: Require equal positive paircount n<capacity. Both max-count horizontal views and actual-count repair exclude slotcapacity-1; odd tails unmarked. Validate sourceWidth-n and both unsigned starts before full contiguous-offset check. No actual offset, count, weight, cacheID or normalizer changes. Array is private/fresh; metadata cannot escape or outlive actual users.
sourceProof.removedWork: Bounded source views remove per-tap variable pixel offsets and associated bounds checks for prepared pairs. Unlike CWW700, contiguity/equal-count proof is performed once peroperation, not perdecodedrow. Current production has no repeated eligibility; no CPU gain inferred.
sourceProof.tests: 19 actual-production partial-assembly cases: original ordered oracle at7geometries and4synthetic count layouts, full-capacity clamped taps, dirty-padding/counts-alias checks, invalid windows, noGC/admission and preparation/execution cancellation. Helpers exist only in test source; no test-only production entry.

geometryAudit.finding: Current production uses indexed offsets, with geometry already prepared once and decode once per retained row. CWW700 bounded pixel windows remove per-tap indexes/checks but test equal counts/contiguity inside every horizontal row; it has no useful robust complete lead. A revised design can prepare eligibility once in existing geometry and reuse the unused last padding slot ONLY for equal positive paircounts strictly below capacity. This eliminates no preparation currently repeated in production: it avoids the repeated eligibility of the prior candidate while seeking its indexing benefit.
geometryAudit.storageProof: Both paircolumns have n<capacity, so their horizontal max-count reads exclude the lastslot. Exact repair reads actualcounts; fullcapacity/unequalcounts/odd tails remain unmarked. Marker is inside admitted offsets, before separate counts/rowIDs; weights are separate. No new array/owner/reservation/pool/API. Prove contiguous valid source ranges once, including all offsets for arbitrary internal test data, before marking. Existing narrow8tap marker has its own16slot format and stays unchanged.
geometryAudit.numerical: Keep every ordered doubleMultiply/Add, zero-weight tap, normalizer, certificate and original-order Q30/rational repair. Use the exact original indexed fallback. CWW tests are leads for actual C# behavioral coverage, not retained obsolete production kernels.
geometryAudit.decision: Source/geometry models support a bounded production prototype, not automatic merge or a performance claim. Reuse existing Wide8 complete short and useful independent confirmation, then seven affected companions/coherent qualification. Verify actual JIT removes the per-tap checks and avoids per-row eligibility; do not infer speed from model counts or repeat overlap/four-output variants.
geometryAudit.scope: Four existing support geometries, shared by byte/word controls, no new image/settings grid. Six synthetic padding schedules are source-model sanity only, not actual C# tests or a statistical benchmark. Current CWA699 profile and CPP657/CWW700 raw providers reused without fresh capture or whole-library audit.
